snippet.title: TruckSimulation 16 - release trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
In TruckSimulation 16 you will take true-to-life control of one of seven real trucks. Start out with a rickety old clunker and earn your first coins in a variety of supply contracts across a large road network in Western and Central Europe. Use the money you earn to purchase better trucks, such as five faithfully reproduced MAN tractor units and the original Castrol Team Hahn racing truck!

TruckSimulation 16 for iPhone®, iPad® and smartphones and tablets with Android™ available now in the Apple® App Store℠ and on Google Play™.

More information can also be found on our official website and the Facebook page for the game:

https://www.facebook.com/TruckSimulationMobile/
http://www.trucksimulation16.com
